login.title: Open your portal
login.description: Enter the API key you were given to view connection details and usage.
login.keyHint: The key stays in this browser tab and is never saved by the portal.
login.error: This key could not be authenticated. Check it and try again.

overview.title: Welcome, {{name}}
overview.description: Connect your tools, check what this key can call, and track settled spend.

connect.title: Connect
connect.description: Choose an allowed model, then copy a ready-to-run example.
connect.noCompatibleExamplesDescription: This model is allowed, but none of the supported client wire formats match these examples.
connect.copyError: Could not copy. Try again in a secure browser context.

models.title: Allowed models
models.description: Live routes and capabilities available to this key.
models.emptyDescription: Ask the operator to expose a route and grant this key access.
models.loadError: Could not load allowed models. Retry.

quota.title: Quota windows
quota.description: The spending windows currently applied to this key.
quota.loadError: Could not load quota windows. Retry.
quota.emptyDescription: This key currently has no configured cost window.

usage.title: Usage and cost
usage.description: Settled usage for this key over the selected range.

recent.title: Recent settled requests
recent.description: The latest settled requests for this key. Request and response bodies are never shown here.
recent.loadError: Could not load recent requests. Retry.
recent.emptyDescription: Completed requests will appear here after settlement.

recentRequests.title: User portal request history
recentRequests.description: Control whether key holders can view their own settled request summaries.
recentRequests.label: Show recent settled requests
recentRequests.hint: This exposes metadata and usage only, never captured request or response bodies.
recentRequests.saveError: Could not save the portal request-history setting. Retry.
recentRequests.loadError: Could not load the portal request-history setting. Retry.

hero.title: One request. Every provider dialect. Nothing dropped.
hero.description: Send the wire your client already speaks. GPROXY translates directly, preserves unknown fields, and makes every response pass through settlement.

claims.title: Many wires enter. Every response exits through settlement.
claims.convergenceLabel: OpenAI Chat, Claude Messages, and Gemini converge on one settlement funnel.

compile.title: Skipping billing is a compile error.
compile.body: Every response carries a proof token only the settlement funnel can construct. Bypass it and Rust refuses the build.

pairwise.title: No IR sands off the edges.
pairwise.body: Conversions are direct pairs between real wire formats. There is no hub schema deciding which details survive.

unknown.title: Unknown fields survive the round trip.
unknown.body: Every typed model retains unmodeled JSON. A field a provider ships today still reaches your client.

cli.title: Your CLIs stay vendor-native.
cli.body: Codex CLI and Claude Code run against pooled credentials through the same metered execution path.

providers.title: 28 providers. One base URL.
providers.body: Pool credentials, fail over between route members, and enforce spend limits per key without reconfiguring clients.

runtime.title: Native binary or wasm at the edge.
runtime.body: The same framework-free request and outcome boundary runs behind a TCP host or a fetch worker.
